content: Scaling laws are one of the most critical empirical findings in deep learning. The observation is simple in form: the training loss $L$ decreases predictably as we scale up model size $N$, dataset size $D$, and compute $C$, following a power-law curve, which appears as a straight line on a log-log plot. opens a PR (resources.create_resource_pr) -> merge. On that merged bot PR, the repo
is read mechanically from the PR body's `- **Link**:` field (no CSV/ID coupling) and
gets a one-time "featured in Awesome Claude Code" welcome issue. Also supports manual
workflow_dispatch with an OWNER/REPO (or URL) input.

- scripts/badges/badge_notification.py: slim, requests-only single-repo notifier.
  --from-pr-body (reads PR_BODY) or --repo owner/name|URL, plus --name/--dry-run.
  Skips Anthropic; not idempotent by design (pipeline adds once → notifies once;
  manual runs are the maintainer's call — avoids rate-limited search calls). Never
  fails the merge.
